text:
Olivia: heads-up: rolling embed-service v2.3.1 to prod in ~10m during the change window (21:00-22:00 UTC). will run the low-risk path and keep canary at 5% :eyes:
Sam: noted, I put the preflight smoke check on the deploy job. watching p95 and 5xx dashboards.
Maya: tagging @oncall in case alerts fire. runbook is at https://confluence/redwood/deploys/runbook (see canary → rollback criteria).
deploy-bot: deploy started: embed-service v2.3.1 → prod (canary=5%). logs: https://ci/redwood/builds/8821
Sam: quick check — can someone open the SLO dashboard and pin the p95 panel? link: https://grafana/redwood/d/embed-service-slo
Leon: I'm seeing a small bump in request latency at canary, p95 +120ms but still within amber threshold. 5xx rate looks flat so far.
Olivia: good. hold for 10m, if p95 > +200ms or 5xx rate > 0.3% we pause and evaluate.
pagerduty-bot: Alert triggered: embed-service_5xx_rate (warn) — 0.35% over 5m window. Incident: INC-5432
Maya: saw that. starting triage. rolling back traffic to 0% for canary. Sam, can you run the quick revert?
Sam: running: /deploy revert embed-service --from v2.3.1 --to v2.3.0 --canary 0 --reason "5xx spike"
deploy-bot: rollback initiated. ETA ~2m.
Olivia: while rollback is in flight, let's pin traffic routing for stable variant v2.3.0 in the routing policy and add a short-term rule to avoid v2.3.1 for 1h.
Sam: pinned routing rule added: {
  "service": "embed-service",
  "pin_version": "v2.3.0",
  "expires": "172345...+3600s"
} (config push ok)
Leon: post-rollback check: 5xx rate back to 0.05% and p95 returned to baseline. Good.
Maya: filing a rollback blameless note and adding this to nightly postmortem. tagging model-oncall for possible regression in tokenization path.
Olivia: action items: 1) block v2.3.1 for an hour, 2) run canary with additional perf telemetry locally, 3) add an eval set that exercises long prompt paths.
deploy-bot: Deployment rolled back successfully. embed-service now at v2.3.0. Canary=0%.
Olivia: thanks all. closing this thread — will reopen if the incident page needs updates. :white_check_mark:
